tests.command:
root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-1: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f .gitignore ] || { echo "FAIL AC-1: .gitignore is missing at the repo root"; exit 1; }
problems=""
for pat in 'backend/test.db' '*.db' '*.db-journal' '*.db-wal' '*.db-shm' '.env.local' '.env.*.local'; do
  if ! grep -qxF -- "$pat" .gitignore; then
    problems="$problems\n  .gitignore is missing the line: $pat"
  fi
done
# --no-index: consults .gitignore only. backend/test.db is still a TRACKED
# file (untracking is the documented follow-up) and index-aware check-ignore
# never reports tracked paths as ignored, which would mask an armed rule.
for p in backend/test.db backend/whatever.db backend/whatever.db-journal backend/whatever.db-wal backend/whatever.db-shm .env.local .env.production.local; do
  if ! git check-ignore -q --no-index -- "$p"; then
    problems="$problems\n  git check-ignore: $p is not ignored"
  fi
done
if [ -n "$problems" ]; then
  printf "%b\n" "$problems"
  echo "FAIL AC-1: .gitignore does not cover the DB sidecars / local dot-env files (want the lines backend/test.db, *.db, *.db-journal, *.db-wal, *.db-shm, .env.local, .env.*.local; detail above)"
  exit 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-1: .gitignore covers backend/test.db, *.db, *.db-journal, *.db-wal, *.db-shm, .env.local and .env.*.local - all seven check-ignore probes are ignored"
exit 0

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-2: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/tests/conftest.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/tests/conftest.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-2: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
out="backend/.scratch/_t25ac2.out"
pre_untracked=$(git status --porcelain | grep '^??' | sort)
mkdir -p backend/.scratch; rm -f "$out"
finish() {
  rm -f "$out"
  rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  git checkout -- backend/test.db 2>/dev/null
  exit "$1"
}
# Arm A: a DATABASE_URL-less run is refused fast, before collection, with an actionable message.
( cd backend && env -u DATABASE_URL timeout 60 .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:randomly > ../"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-2: pytest WITHOUT DATABASE_URL exited 0 - conftest must refuse DATABASE_URL-less runs (the sqlite:///./test.db setdefault default must go)"
  finish 1
fi
if [ $rc -ge 124 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-2: the DATABASE_URL-less run did not fail fast (timeout 60 hit, rc=$rc) - the refusal must happen at conftest import, not after a long run"
  finish 1
fi
low=$(tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' < "$out")
case "$low" in *database_url*) : ;; *) echo "FAIL AC-2: the refusal does not name the DATABASE_URL env var"; finish 1 ;; esac
case "$low" in *sqlite*) : ;; *) echo "FAIL AC-2: the refusal carries no actionable sqlite URL direction"; finish 1 ;; esac
if grep -qE "[0-9]+ (passed|failed|collected)" "$out"; then
  echo "FAIL AC-2: tests were collected or run despite the missing DATABASE_URL - the refusal must precede collection"
  finish 1
fi
post_untracked=$(git status --porcelain | grep '^??' | grep -vE '^\?\? backend/\.scratch' | sort)
new_untracked=$(comm -13 <(printf "%s\n" "$pre_untracked") <(printf "%s\n" "$post_untracked"))
if [ -n "$new_untracked" ] || ls backend/tq_test_*.db > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "FAIL AC-2: the refused run left artifacts behind (new untracked files or tq_test_*.db in backend/)"
  finish 1
fi
# Arm B (positive control): with DATABASE_URL set, collection proceeds.
( cd backend && ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db JWT_SECRET="t25ac2-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:randomly > ../"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -5 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-2: pytest --collect-only WITH DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db exited $rc - the positive control must collect"
  finish 1
fi
collected=$(grep -oE "[0-9]+ tests? collected" "$out" | grep -oE "^[0-9]+" | head -1)
if [ -z "$collected" ] || [ "$collected" -lt 300 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-2: the positive control collected $collected tests (want >= 300) - the refusal is over-broad"
  finish 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-2: a DATABASE_URL-less pytest run is refused fast at conftest (names DATABASE_URL, points at sqlite, nothing collected, no artifacts); with DATABASE_URL set, $collected tests collect"
finish 0

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-3: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/tests/conftest.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/tests/conftest.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-3: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
out="backend/.scratch/_t25ac3.out"
pre_untracked=$(git status --porcelain | grep '^??' | sort)
mkdir -p backend/.scratch; rm -f "$out"
finish() {
  rm -f "$out"
  rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  git checkout -- backend/test.db 2>/dev/null
  exit "$1"
}
( cd backend && ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db JWT_SECRET="t25ac3-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest -q -p no:randomly > ../"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
summary=$(grep -E "passed|failed|error" "$out" | tail -1 | xargs)
if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || ! echo "$summary" | grep -qE "^[0-9]+ passed, 2 xfailed(, [0-9]+ warnings)? in "; then
  tail -5 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the backend floor moved (want rc 0 with at least 347 passed, exactly 2 xfailed, and 0 failed; got rc=$rc: $summary)"
  finish 1
fi
passed=$(echo "$summary" | grep -oE "^[0-9]+ passed" | grep -oE "[0-9]+")
if [ -z "$passed" ] || [ "$passed" -lt 347 ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the passed floor shrank below the groom baseline (want >= 347 passed, got $passed)"
  finish 1
fi
if ! ( cd backend && .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe check . > ../"$out" 2>&1 ); then
  cat "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: ruff is not clean"
  finish 1
fi
if ls backend/tq_test_*.db > /dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "FAIL AC-3: tq_test_*.db scratch files remain in backend/ after the run"
  finish 1
fi
post_untracked=$(git status --porcelain | grep '^??' | grep -vE '^\?\? backend/\.scratch' | sort)
new_untracked=$(comm -13 <(printf "%s\n" "$pre_untracked") <(printf "%s\n" "$post_untracked"))
if [ -n "$new_untracked" ]; then
  printf "%s\n" "$new_untracked"
  echo "FAIL AC-3: the suite run left new untracked files in the repo (list above)"
  finish 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-3: $passed passed, 2 xfailed, 0 failed + ruff clean + zero new untracked files + no tq_test_*.db left (test.db restored)"
finish 0

root=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) || root=.
cd "$root" || { echo "FAIL AC-4: cannot cd to the repo root"; exit 1; }
[ -f backend/tests/conftest.py ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not run from the TableQueue repo root (backend/tests/conftest.py missing)"; exit 1; }
[ -x backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe ] || { echo "FAIL AC-4: not measured - backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe is missing (create the suite venv: cd backend && uv sync)"; exit 1; }
out="backend/.scratch/_t25ac4.out"
mkdir -p backend/.scratch; rm -f "$out"
finish() {
  rm -f "$out"
  rmdir backend/.scratch 2>/dev/null
  rm -rf backend/.pytest_cache
  git checkout -- backend/test.db 2>/dev/null
  exit "$1"
}
# Arm (a): conftest carries no /tmp reference.
if grep -n "/tmp/" backend/tests/conftest.py > "$out" 2>&1; then
  cat "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: backend/tests/conftest.py carries a /tmp/ reference (the refusal/default must not point at a /tmp database)"
  finish 1
fi
# Arm (b) cleanup: remove any pre-existing landmine file at both /tmp resolutions.
for d in /tmp "C:/tmp"; do
  rm -f "$d/tq_b06_pytest.db" "$d/tq_b06_pytest.db-journal" "$d/tq_b06_pytest.db-wal" "$d/tq_b06_pytest.db-shm" 2>/dev/null
done
# Arm (b): the landmine modules run green and do not materialize the /tmp file.
( cd backend && ENV=development DATABASE_URL=sqlite:///./test.db JWT_SECRET="t25ac4-secret-0123456789-abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz" STAFF_PIN=0000 TZ=UTC .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m pytest tests/test_public_board.py tests/test_public_waitlist.py tests/test_rate_limit_t23.py -q -p no:randomly > ../"$out" 2>&1 )
rc=$?
if [ $rc -ne 0 ]; then
  tail -5 "$out"
  echo "FAIL AC-4: the landmine test modules are not green (rc=$rc) - the conftest change must not break them"
  finish 1
fi
found=""
for d in /tmp "C:/tmp"; do
  if [ -e "$d/tq_b06_pytest.db" ]; then found="$found $d/tq_b06_pytest.db"; fi
done
if [ -n "$found" ]; then
  echo "FAIL AC-4: the run materialized the audited landmine file:$found - the module-level setdefaults must stay inert"
  finish 1
fi
echo "PASS AC-4: conftest carries no /tmp reference, the landmine modules run green, and no tq_b06_pytest.db exists in /tmp or C:/tmp after the run (pre-existing copies cleaned)"
finish 0
